mapper.insert:
insert into cost_review_issue ( review_task_id, project_id, left_item_id, right_item_id, boq_item_id, compare_result_id, item_side, item_code_snapshot, item_name_snapshot, issue_type, issue_level, issue_title, issue_description, original_value, reference_value, difference_value, difference_rate, risk_amount, rule_code, evidence_json, status, create_by, create_time, del_flag ) values
(#{i.reviewTaskId}, #{i.projectId}, #{i.leftItemId}, #{i.rightItemId}, #{i.boqItemId}, #{i.compareResultId}, #{i.itemSide}, #{i.itemCodeSnapshot}, #{i.itemNameSnapshot}, #{i.issueType}, #{i.issueLevel}, #{i.issueTitle}, #{i.issueDescription}, #{i.originalValue}, #{i.referenceValue}, #{i.differenceValue}, #{i.differenceRate}, #{i.riskAmount}, #{i.ruleCode}, #{i.evidenceJson}, #{i.status}, #{i.createBy}, #{i.createTime}, '0')
mapper.select: select * from cost_review_issue where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
mapper.update: update cost_review_issue set status = #{request.status}, issue_level = #{request.issueLevel}, reviewer_user_id = #{reviewerUserId}, reviewer = #{reviewer}, review_comment = #{request.reviewComment}, review_time = sysdate(), update_by = #{reviewer}, update_time = sysdate() where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0'

update cost_review_issue set ai_has_issue = #{result.hasIssueFlag}, ai_issue_type = #{result.issueType}, ai_issue_level = #{result.riskLevel}, ai_title = #{result.title}, ai_analysis = #{result.analysis}, ai_suggestion = #{result.suggestion}, ai_confidence = #{result.confidence}, ai_model = #{result.model}, ai_request_id = #{result.requestId}, ai_analyzed_user_id = #{userId}, ai_analyzed_by = #{username}, ai_analyzed_time = sysdate(), update_by = #{username}, update_time = sysdate() where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0'

update cost_review_issue i inner join cost_review_task r on r.id = i.review_task_id set i.del_flag = '2', i.update_by = #{updateBy}, i.update_time = sysdate() where i.del_flag = '0' and (r.left_batch_id = #{boqBatchId} or r.right_batch_id = #{boqBatchId})
